To make payments in person or by credit card please visit the Town of Valleyview Administration Office at 4909 – 50th Street'

note: Town of Valleyview municipal RV park on 50th Street north, within walking distance of the Greenview Regional Multiplex and downtown; a stocked trout pond and new playground beside the campground are open to campers. Water is seasonal; winter stays are power only. --Claude
summary: Town page read: 12 stalls with power and (seasonal) water, dump station, self-registration confirmed and made manual; fees widened to C$25 (winter, power only) - C$35 (summer) with weekly/monthly rates; season set year-round from the summer and winter rates. Note cleaned.
flags: SEASON: the page gives no open/close dates but posts summer (power and water) and winter (power only) rates for the RV park, so year_round true was written; reviewer may prefer to leave season unknown.

PHONE/WEBSITE: https://valleyview.ca/lifestyle-leisure/camping/ answered 200; 780-524-5150 (Town office, on the page and Google) matches stored. Google 4.1 from 30 reviews. Electric amperage not stated.
PIN (55.07601,-117.28093): on 50th Street at the entrance, about 120 m south-east of the stall grid; optional move to about 55.0767,-117.2823 (Google 55.07642,-117.28145).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - left; evidence distance is wrong): on Esri imagery the trout pond (about 0.25 ha, L-shaped) lies west of the stall grid; its east edge is about 35-40 m from the grid's west loop road across open grass and a fence line, not ~150 m as the stored evidence says. The 12 stalls are pull-in spaces between the grid's roads, none facing the pond. Pond would need a pad at the edge; not proposing an upgrade.
